progress: Lobby in 2:40, plan and nine orders placed, 8 of 9 parts delivered; the camera was contracted too late, so the launch scrubbed on day 180 with 0 of 2 goals and no way to continue.

findings.title: Procurement could not confirm orders: the quote goes stale every game day, so 'Confirm order' keeps turning into 'Refresh quote'
One contracted part arriving after launch day ended the whole game: the launch fires by itself, scrubs, and nothing can be tried afterwards
Science had nothing to do for the whole mission: no research could matter and none was started
Planner could not find how to move the launch date, although the control exists and would have saved the mission
Procurement was not told which need has to be ordered first; the camera's three-month lead time was found too late
When the standard delivery turned late, Procurement's suggestion jumped to the cheapest and latest supplier and hid the one that could still deliver on time
Planner finished in 45 seconds and then had no decision left until launch
Comms options marked 'affects planner' change nothing the Planner can see or do, so the two stations could not decide them together in time
A scrubbed launch is shown as a launched mission: 'LAUNCHED · T+30 d', 'Mission launched', and flight events that never happened
The message about the late delivery sold an expediting bonus that sped up a different delivery
Joining took 2 min 40 s: one invite and one reply code per player, handed over one after another
Players could not tell that the budget is shared or who had just spent from it
A finished one-off Comms project (Laser link licence) is offered again
Science screen gave no hint which research the mission needs
The result screen did not say what could have been done about the late part, or whether anything can be tried again
Before the Planner ordered, Procurement saw 77 parts and 'No open mission needs' and could not tell whether the game had started or what to buy
Share of the failed order confirmations and missed clicks that comes from agent latency
